title: chat-mimi-server: opt-in conditional for KeyPackage/set
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C9i. Crates: jmap-chat-mimi-server. Size: M.

Apply the C7 pattern (docs/design/conditional.md §5.1, §7; decision 1 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md). register_mimi_conditional for KeyPackage/set; register_mimi_handlers unchanged; memory Inner (no openmls storage) on ScopedState with hub request queue in Inner + ConditionalBackend; Atomic final-state: KeyPackageRef reuse, maxKeyPackages. Acceptance: precondition, atomic rollback (no hub request emitted), maxKeyPackages met only by final state; public-api additions only.
